gaps.statement: Conditional single-junction PV limits are conflated with universal conversion limits.
Spectral routing, thermal reuse, and electrical conversion lack a joined architecture-level treatment.
Input and output boundaries vary among device, module, receiver, and system reports.
Spectrum, temperature, optical losses, electrical load, calibration, and uncertainty are not consistently co-reported.
Peak-efficiency components lack a shared stability and degradation transfer gate.
Laboratory source conditions are over-transferred to deployment claims.
